sentences.en: The hotel offers both standard suites and family rooms.
sentences.zh: 这家酒店提供标准套房和家庭房两种房间类型。

sentences.en: We upgraded our reservation to a standard suite with a balcony.
sentences.zh: 我们将预订升级为带阳台的标准套房。

sentences.en: The standard suite comes with a king-size bed and a minibar.
sentences.zh: 标准套房配备了一张特大号床和一个迷你吧。
